# FSM_REST UML Index

**Workshop moniker:** @TrentBest  
**Purpose:** Navigate source-grounded structural diagrams and use cases. Diagrams are manually authored unless a page explicitly says otherwise; no page is claimed to be generated by AST/reflection or GUI.SVG.

## Integration groups

Integration diagrams are grouped by boundary so consumers can find optional adapters without confusing them with the dependency-light core:

- [GUI integration UML](GUI/README.md) — presentation mapping, input binding, node creation, and GUI operation execution.
- [OpenAPI integration UML](OpenAPI/README.md) — OpenAPI JSON import and definition-URL connection.
- [FSM_COS / MicroBundleDomain integration UML](FSM_COS/README.md) — composition adapter and descriptor conversion helpers. FSM_REST core depends directly on FSM_API, not FSM_COS.

The target-specific pages remain linked below for direct access.

## Coverage policy

Each production source file must have a neighboring companion. Each public class, record, or interface must have a focused UML page or be explicitly represented as a target in a cohesive diagram with a use-case section. Pages identify their target, source, purpose, relationships, scope, provenance, and verification path.

## Inventory status

This index is a navigation aid, not a completed coverage audit. The listed pages are manually maintained unless each page explicitly identifies another provenance. The full required view inventory (sequence, control flow, lifecycle, architecture, data flow, test traceability, and applicability decisions) still needs a repository-wide reconciliation against source, projects, MicroBundles, and tests.

## Known gap

The inventory is substantially expanded, but this index does not yet prove that every declared public type has an individually complete UML page or that every relative link resolves. Follow [FSM_REST Documentation Readiness](../FSM_REST.DOCUMENTATION_READINESS.md) for remaining audit and CI work. Do not interpret documentation coverage as runtime proof.
